name: SoundHound AI
oneLiner: Nasdaq-listed voice AI company whose restaurant products answer phone orders, take drive-thru orders and power kiosks, now built on its OASYS agentic AI platform.
bestFor: High-volume QSR and casual-dining chains that want to automate phone ordering and drive-thru order taking across many locations, with POS integration and enterprise rollout support.

updates.text: Q2 2025 results named new restaurant deals with Red Lobster, Peter Piper Pizza and Applebee's / IHOP and expansion with Chipotle; later in 2025 it bought Interactions, a customer-service virtual assistant company.
Five Guys extended its partnership after more than one million AI phone ordering interactions, letting franchisees add the phone ordering agent at their own locations.
Launched OASYS (Orchestrated Agent System), a self-learning agentic AI platform for building agents that run across phones, drive-thrus, kiosks, web chat and vehicles.

features: AI phone ordering that answers calls, takes orders and handles menu, hours and allergen questions
Drive-thru voice ordering, including with Acrelec drive-thru hardware
Kiosk and in-car voice ordering channels
POS integration so orders go straight to the kitchen
Upselling and promotion prompts during orders
Voice Insights that turn drive-thru conversations into operational data
OASYS platform for building agents once and deploying them across channels
notes: Public company (Nasdaq: SOUN). It acquired Amelia (2024), SYNQ3 Restaurant Solutions (2024) and Interactions (2025); a LivePerson acquisition was reported as planned in 2026 (not verified in detail). Kept from current review: Chipotle and Church's Texas Chicken (confirmed). White Castle is a confirmed earlier (2023) drive-thru partner (qsrweb.com) but not shown in recent filings; Jersey Mike's is reported by Zacks as a growing location count in 2026 but not confirmed by a primary source here, so both left out of customers. Dropped from current review: 'no human in the loop' / 'no human agents' framing (not verified as a vendor claim) and 'one of the most widely deployed' (vendor reports voice AI in 10,000+ restaurant locations per its 2025 Acrelec release; vendor-reported). Text and scan-to-order not re-confirmed.
